name: Cervical Epidural Abscess
definition: Purulent collection in the cervical epidural space causing potential spinal cord compression and rapid neurological deterioration.

investigations.principle: Urgent contrast MRI is the diagnostic test of choice.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Neurological compromise may require urgent decompression plus antimicrobial therapy.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Emergency modern diagnosis and decompression take priority over Ayurvedic treatment.

patientEducation.summary: Purulent collection in the cervical epidural space causing potential spinal cord compression and rapid neurological deterioration.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
